'''Small shipwrecks''' are a type of [[Shipwreck salvaging|salvageable shipwreck]] found at sea, requiring level 15 [[Sailing]] to salvage from with a [[salvaging hook]]. Small shipwrecks will yield [[small salvage]], granting 10 Sailing experience; these can then be sorted at a [[salvaging station]] (or the [[Salvaging station (facility)|boat facility]]), granting loot and an additional 5.5 Sailing experience.

When it is salvaged by a player ship, it will remain salvageable for 2 minutes and 30 seconds, after which it reverts into a [[sunken shipwreck#Small|sunken shipwreck]]. After sinking, another sunken shipwreck in the area will revert back to a small shipwreck and become salvageable again.

The chance to successfully salvage is affected by the salvaging hook used and Sailing level: better salvaging hooks and a higher Sailing level increases the likelihood of successfully receiving salvage. At Level 15 Sailing, with [[Bronze salvaging hook]], you get approximately 1600 xp/hr salvaging small shipwrecks depending on attentiveness.

At [[Shipwreck cove]], and using a [[Sloop]], with just the correct positioning (shown to the right) one can have two crewmates on the salvaging hooks and reach all three shipwrecks without needing to move. If wanting to reach them with yourself on one of the hooks as well, you will need to move between the tile shown and two tiles north of it. To get into position, line up the centre of your [[helm]] with the tile as shown in the image, and the port side of your boat with the glowing spyglass charting location, your salvaging hook should be slightly south of it.
